??? quote "Dialogue"

    - The old north stair runs up the cliff out on [The North Ridge](../maps/north_ridge.md). Eleven years ago a rockfall took it, and my uncle Baruk with it. I dug for him all night while my father kept the fire.
    - We patched the stair afterwards. Patched it, not rebuilt it, because nobody had the heart to cut there. I've climbed every scaffold in this town since, and I've never once gone back up that stair to look.

    - The patch on the old north stair, on [The North Ridge](../maps/north_ridge.md). Look at the joints and the rock above.
    - It holds? The wedges tight, no new cracks above? Then it was good work, though the men who did it were weeping while they cut.
    - My daughter wants to cut a new stairway further south, on sounder rock. I keep a copy of her sketch in my coat. Don't tell her.
